title: Grand Admiral Thrawn
description: Brilliant, ruthless, and cunning, Grand Admiral Thrawn was one of the most resourceful military minds in the Imperial Navy. Known for studying art to better understand the machinations of his enemies, the mysteries of the Force proved to be his undoing. Exiled to another galaxy thanks to young Ezra Bridger, Thrawn spent years plotting his return to the galaxy to plunge the New Republic into war.
